subject.title: fix(agents): repair orphaned tool_use pairs on compaction prune path

question: Should compaction drop aborted assistant tool-call turns with missing results before summarization, matching the prompt-send sanitizer behavior, or preserve them with a synthetic/annotated result instead?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and well covered, but the permanent behavior is a session-state policy choice between losing an interrupted partial turn and fabricating context for the summarizer.

options.title: Accept Drop Policy
options.body: Merge after accepting that aborted tool-call turns are removed from compaction input so strict providers never see orphaned tool-use blocks.

options.title: Require Synthetic Recovery
options.body: Ask for a revised patch that keeps the aborted turn by adding a clearly synthetic or unknown-status tool result with equivalent compaction tests.

options.title: Pause For Broader Policy
options.body: Hold this PR until the related unknown-result semantics are decided in the broader transcript-repair work.

recommendation.title: Accept Drop Policy
recommendation.body: Merge after accepting that aborted tool-call turns are removed from compaction input so strict providers never see orphaned tool-use blocks.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest history owner for the transcript repair helper and compaction planning surface where this policy lands.
